record.oneLiner: An armoured nodosaur from the Cretaceous of Wyoming.
record.description: Nodosaurus was a nodosaurid ankylosaur — an armoured herbivore without a tail club — from the Late Cretaceous of Wyoming. It was one of the first armoured dinosaurs described from North America.

notableFacts.text: Its back was covered in bands of bony armour, but it lacked a tail club.
One of the first armoured dinosaurs named from North America, during the Bone Wars.
